# Packages whose version can change the numbers in the committed PMMH output,
# rather than only whether the code runs. That output is the three chain CSVs
# under data/ and the deck figures drawn from them under sessions/slides/images/,
# which CONTRIBUTING.md treats as one unit: change what produced the chains and
# both have to be regenerated.
#
# The sessions load that output instead of regenerating it, because a full PMMH
# run takes hours. So the site render shows a bump broke no code path, and shows
# nothing about whether the sampler still produces the committed draws. One
# workflow reads this list: compathelper_automerge.yml keeps a bump to any of
# these off auto-merge, so a person decides whether to widen the bound.
#
# That is the whole of what this list does today. Nothing checks the committed
# output against the versions that produced it, and a widened bound is only the
# permission for a later move: the version the code loads is the one pinned in
# Manifest.toml, which a widened bound leaves valid, so Pkg.resolve keeps it
# until someone re-resolves. Catching that move needs a check that compares the
# manifest, which is not in place.
#
# One bare name per line, nothing else on the line: the reader matches the whole
# line with grep -qxF. Every name is a direct dependency in Project.toml, which
# is the right universe here because the guard reads a CompatHelper title and
# CompatHelper only bumps direct dependencies. Each earns its place by a traced
# call on the path from a generation script to a committed artefact:
#
#   Turing                 drives sample()
#   AdvancedMH             RobustAdaptiveMetropolis, the proposal itself
#   SSMProblems            the state space model interface
#   GeneralisedFilters     BF, the bootstrap filter the chains run through
#   LogExpFunctions        softmax and logsumexp, which GeneralisedFilters
#                          weights and resamples with
#   JumpProcesses          the stochastic simulator, and the solve it runs on
#   DifferentialEquations  Tsit5, the deterministic fit in
#                          scripts/generate_pmcmc_figures.jl
#   Distributions          the priors and the observation model
#
# LogExpFunctions earns its place through GeneralisedFilters rather than through
# anything here: logsumexp is called only by src/threaded_bootstrap_filter.jl,
# and the chains take the unthreaded BF path. So do not prune it on a grep of
# src/, which is what that evidence looks like at first glance.
#
# Two deliberate absences. AdvancedVI, because nothing committed comes from it.
# And StatsBase, which looks like it belongs and does not: wsample is imported
# at src/MFIIDD.jl:11 and never called, GeneralisedFilters' resamplers.jl holds
# no StatsBase reference, and its only two uses there are a weights overload
# nothing calls and an import in the Rao-Blackwellised filter, which BF is not.
# Anything that did route StatsBase into the draws would arrive as a
# GeneralisedFilters bump, which this list catches.

Turing
AdvancedMH
SSMProblems
GeneralisedFilters
LogExpFunctions
JumpProcesses
DifferentialEquations
Distributions
